notes_for_editor: The only source is the regional site's page, which gives a title and county and nothing else (its coordinates come from a map widget and are not in the page text). The story is far below the brief's 120-word floor because the evidence is that thin; padding it was declined. Consider holding publication until a Taylor County source turns up. Checked without result: two WebSearch queries and one websearch.py query (returned only topographic-map listings of a 'Cabbage Grove Lookout Tower' point near Cabbage Creek, not fetched or cited); the FFLA 2015 Florida field report (no mention); the FFLA Florida index pages in the local cache (no entry); the Aucilla WMA recreation guide (no tower mention). Leads not yet followed: a USGS water-monitoring site named 'Cabbage Grove Fire Tower, Adc.' (search result title only); the Florida Forest Service's Taylor County office; the Taylor County Historical Society; the Florida Master Site File.
